metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the muster, the new hose, and the list for the river.

yesterday: Twenty-six shillings went out of the stock for hose. Pope has his old heel in his hand, and Greenwich is settled for him.
The court went up to Richmond this morning. Sam still has Friday in which to learn a full chair from an empty one.
Nick has kept the order for four days. The order held in the room.
The second shirt and the grey cloak go. The chronicle stays in the room. The pages of the wood stay under the board. She has first light.
